I added a 0.25 s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`. The pause is a `RATE_LIMIT_PAUSE` constant, and a comment next to it notes the sandbox's 5 requests per second limit. That caps the loop at about 4 requests per second, under the limit. I haven't run the test, so I can't say yet whether the flake is gone.

The test only makes four calls, so the sleeps add about a second. If other tests in CI hit the sandbox at the same time, the combined rate could still go over 5 per second. A sleep in this one file wouldn't fix that.
